question: What result is promised to one who performs recitation of this mantra?
premises: Recitation of this mantra is undertaken by a practitioner
A specific outcome is linked to that recitation
inference: Whoever performs recitation of this mantra becomes an unfaltering poet
uncertainties: The antecedent of asyāḥ may be the immediately preceding mantra or a related vidyā
plain_english: Whoever performs the recitation of this mantra will become an unfaltering poet.
